answer: In arXiv 2602.13244, 'LoRA' stands for Low-Rank Adaptation. It relates to model compression by enabling fast and resource-efficient fine-tuning of large models. LoRA allows for the adaptation of only a subset of the model parameters, typically individual layers, which reduces the number of trainable parameters significantly and lowers GPU memory requirements. This makes it possible to reuse and adapt existing models in a cost-effective manner, aligning with the goals of model compression.
